package fixture

func bad(c *gin.Context) {
	_ = Error{Error: "invalid_input"}
	_ = &RequestError{Code: "not_found"}
	c.JSON(400, gin.H{"error": "bad thing"})
	_ = map[string]string{"error": "oops"}
	RespondWithError(c, 400, "invalid_input", "m")
	_ = Error{Error: ErrorError("x")}
}

func helper(c *gin.Context, code string, err error) {
	c.JSON(400, gin.H{"error": code})
	_ = AuthError{Code: "unauthorized"}
	_ = gin.H{"error": err.Error()}
}
